notes: Each 'source' (an Actant in the original schema) is a person, group, or being that speaks or is spoken of in Scripture.

Fields intentionally EXCLUDED because they are computed sphere-linkage/statistics, not basic identity metadata: sphereCount, sphereCounts, sphereWordCount, sourceTypeCount, sourceTypeCounts, wordCount, words, principalSourceType.
actantNumber: 1=Group, 2=Individual, 3=unspecified/other (present in source data but not labeled in the original app UI).
natures/professions/chronologies are resolved from their lookup tables and included inline so this file is self-contained.
